thread:
alex_liu: Heads-up — during the model-XQ quant bring-up I noticed a cluster of near-duplicates leaking into the prompt bank. Looks like both exact-fingerprint duplicates and paraphrase variants slipped through. Need to decide: automated prune criteria vs manual review strata.

tara_labeling: ugh, seen that. how many examples are we talking? can we triage by freq + embed-sim? :thinking_face:

alex_liu: ~2.1k candidates flagged by the initial dedupe pass; ~350 are high-similarity (cos > 0.95) but many low-confidence paraphrases around 0.85-0.90.
sam_platform: quick idea — run a two-stage filter: 1) exact hash de-dupe + keep one per fingerprint, 2) embed-cluster prune with cluster-size cap, 3) surface top-k per cluster for manual review. I can drop a script.
tara_labeling: that matches what we discussed for multilingual holdouts but with different thresholds. For labeling bandwidth we should also create strata: (a) exact duplicates, (b) near-exact (0.9-0.95), (c) paraphrase (0.8-0.9). Only (c) needs a larger manual sample.
jess_sre: labeler capacity next week is limited — we can only handle ~400 manual checks. Can we prioritize clusters by model sensitivity (i.e., where new model changed logits significantly)?
alex_liu: yes — we have per-sample regression delta scores from the quant smoke run. Prioritize where delta >= 0.12 and quality drop in top-3 outputs. That should cut manual set to ~280.
sam_platform: I'll add that as a weight in the sampler. Example command to run locally (Linux):

```bash
python tools/dedupe_prune.py --input promptbank.jsonl --hash-threshold 1 --embed-threshold 0.9 --cluster-cap 5 --priority-metric "delta_score" --priority-threshold 0.12 --out candidates.jsonl
```

Feel free to tweak flags. Output will have `cluster_id`, `representative_id`, `members_count`.
tara_labeling: perfect — for manual review UI we'll want `representative_id` + 3 random members per cluster, and a flag if fingerprint collisions occurred. Also add language tag and token-length bucket.

ci-bot: dedupe-job-17233 finished: scanned 2,114 candidates, clusters found: 422, flagged for manual: 278. Report -> https://internal/reports/dedupe/2479990042

jess_sre: awesome, thanks ci-bot. alex — can you post the prioritized sample list by EOD? i'll reserve the labeler slots and coordinate reviewers.
alex_liu: will do. plan: run full prune with sam's script, generate prioritized candidates, then tara + I will do a 1-hour triage session Wed 10am PT. tagging @tara_labeling @sam_platform.
tara_labeling: confirmed for Wed 10am. i'll draft review rubrics (accept/merge/mark-as-paraphrase/keep).
sam_platform: deploying the script now to the adhoc worker pool. will paste run logs here when done.

ci-bot: run-log: worker-07: started, worker-07: finished in 3m12s, output candidates.jsonl (278 manual).
alex_liu: excellent. small follow-up: add a quick metric in the report — predicted cost delta if we keep duplicates vs prune (tokens/sec * cost). helps product decide aggressive pruning.
jess_sre: good point. add to the report and cc: @product.

ci-bot: report updated with cost delta table and sample preview. 

alex_liu: thanks all — will share the sample list + rubric before Wed. :thumbsup:
